title: Delivery failed — recipient not reachable
summary: Agent is at the address but can't hand over the item.

end: Never leave it unattended without the PIN.
SGH cold chain: release the PIN only after a photo showing an identifiable recipient. Hand over in person only; undeliverable → return to HQ.
If the customer hasn't advised how to receive it, return to sender.
Agent calls the customer and keeps the call log.
Leave in a safe spot and take all 3 PODs.
Send the photo to the customer; note where it was left in the remarks.
Agent calls the customer and keeps the call log.
Arrange a re-attempt (TikTok: one re-attempt within 2 working days).
Still failing → mark Undelivered with POD and call log, then return to sender.
Mark Undelivered with photo proof and call log.
Return the item the next working day; mark Returned with photo proof.
